conversation.Statement: Hello, am I speaking with Olivia? This is Ryan from Amazon Customer Protection. I see you recently placed an order for international delivery, can I quickly confirm a few details for security purposes?
Yes, this is Olivia. Is something wrong with my order? I really need it to arrive on time.

Thank you, Olivia. Actually, that's why I'm calling. There's been a security flag on your account due to multiple login attempts from outside the United States. We want to make sure your deliveries aren't interrupted and your account remains secure.
Oh no, I'm in Spain right now for work, so maybe that's me. What do I need to do?
I understand completely, and that's likely why the system flagged it. To verify you're the authorized user, can you confirm the last four digits of the phone number linked to your Amazon account?
Sure, it's 8821.
Perfect, thank you. One more thing, Olivia: for your security, I need to confirm your full delivery address, just to ensure your packages aren't being rerouted.
It's Calle Mayor 18, Madrid, Spain, 28013.

Thank you for confirming. Now, unfortunately, our system is showing an unauthorized purchase of a high-value laptop on your account, shipping is set to a different address in the UK. Did you authorize this purchase?
No, absolutely not! I haven't ordered a laptop.

That's what I was afraid of. Don't worry, we can stop this, but I need you to work with me closely, if we don't act, the transaction will be processed shortly. I really don't want to lose my job over this, so I appreciate your cooperation.
Of course, please tell me what to do.
Thank you, Olivia. First, I need to verify your identity through our secure protocol. Do you currently have access to your email and a computer or smartphone?
Yes, I have my laptop with me.
Great. Can you please log in to your Amazon account, but don't make any changes yet? I'll walk you through the security check.
Okay, I'm logged in now.

Thank you for following instructions, Olivia; you're making this much easier for both of us. Now, I need you to install a quick verification tool called 'Amazon Support Connect.' It's similar to TeamViewer, just for secure sessions. May I guide you to the download link?
Um, sure, where do I get it?
Please open your browser and go to www.amsupportconnect.com. Let me know when you see the download option.
Alright, I've got the page open and see a download button.
Perfect. Please click to download and install. Once open, it will display a session code. Could you read that code out to me?
It says my session code is 643229.
Thank you, Olivia. I'm connecting now. This will let me see the flagged transaction and cancel it on your behalf. Please don't touch your keyboard or mouse for a moment.
Okay, I won't touch anything.

Alright, I've found the unauthorized order, but there's a complication. It seems a payment attempt for £1,700 was charged to your linked bank card. If it goes through, it could take days to reverse. The only way to block it is to verify a secure transaction from your end.
Wait, what do I need to do? I can't afford to lose that much money.

Don't worry, there's a solution. Amazon's policy for international fraud cases is to temporarily offset the charge using a secure gift card transaction. I know it sounds odd, but it's the fastest way for our compliance team to freeze the funds and reverse the unauthorized payment. Please don't worry, it's a standard protocol and fully refundable.
So you want me to buy Amazon gift cards or something?

Yes, that's correct. You'll need to purchase Amazon gift cards totaling £1,700 and read me the codes. Once our system verifies the codes, the funds will be credited back to your account immediately. I promise, I'd never ask if it weren't required. If this isn't resolved, my supervisor will hold me responsible.
I've never done this before, but if it really protects my account, okay. Should I buy them online?

Yes, you can buy them directly through Amazon or from a local retailer. The important thing is to take clear photos of the card numbers or receipt codes and send them to this secure email address: refunds@amsupportconnect.com. Please let me know as soon as you have them.
Alright, I'll do it now. This is making me nervous though.

I completely understand, Olivia. I'd be concerned too, but trust me, you're doing the right thing. As soon as we process the codes, your money will be returned and the fraudulent order will be cancelled. I truly appreciate your cooperation, it means a lot to me personally.
Okay, I've purchased the cards. Should I just read the codes out to you?
Yes, please read each code carefully. I'll confirm them as you go to make sure everything is processed correctly.
Alright, the first code is 3XKJ-9N7GM-5QPL.
Thank you, that's valid. Please continue with the next code.
The next one is 7PLQ-5JNNM-4LRV.
Got it. That's two. Please finish with the rest.
Here are the last two: 1FMV-6YTRD-8BQP and 0DLK-2ZQPM-7XWS.

All received and verified, Olivia. Thank you so much for your quick action. The refund will be processed to your original payment method within two hours. You just saved your account from a major loss, and honestly, you saved my job too.
Thank you. I just hope everything is safe now. Please let me know if there's anything else I need to do.

You've done everything right. I'll send a confirmation email shortly. If you have any concerns, you can always reply to that message. Thank you again for your trust and assistance, and have a safe rest of your trip.
